title: Execution-time prediction contract (cycles headline; nanoseconds gated)
description: Closed-object contract emitted by tools/local_labels/emit_timing_prediction_contract.py into data/local_labels/timing_prediction_contract_sm_86.json. It fixes the execution-time prediction publication discipline for the local RTX 3090 Ti (sm_86, GA102 / Ampere): the DVFS-stable cycle count gpc__cycles_elapsed.max is the sole publication headline target; the derived wall-clock nanosecond leg is a clock-uncertainty interval that may not close the success terminal state on its own and is gated behind a CUPTI-Activity-vs-NCU agreement (crosswalk) artifact plus a cohort long enough to clear the measured dual-source noise floor. The contract pins the exact cycle-error definition, the publication and smoke coverage tiers, the deploy-nanosecond prerequisites and floor-relative cohort thresholds, the terminal-state vocabulary, and the single-architecture evidence statuses. additionalProperties is false at every level; literal thresholds are pinned with const so any drift fails closed at validation time.

schema_version.description: Schema format version. Bumped only when fields are added, removed, or change semantics.

artifact_kind.description: Fixed discriminator identifying this artifact kind.

arch.description: Single-architecture scope. This contract is authored and witnessed only on the local RTX 3090 Ti (sm_86); the Blackwell laptop arch is out of scope for this artifact.

source_commit.description: Commit the contract was emitted from, or the literal 'unknown' when git is unavailable at emit time.

publication_target_metric_id.description: The sole publication headline target is the DVFS-stable elapsed cycle count. Pinning this as a const means a contract that names the nanosecond metric (or any other metric) as the headline fails validation.

publication_target_registry_key.description: Metric-registry key for the headline target.

is_sole_publication_headline.description: The cycle count is the only publication headline. No co-equal nanosecond headline is admitted.

rationale.description: Why cycles is load-bearing: it is DVFS-stable, whereas the nanosecond value is the cycle count multiplied by a clock conversion that double-counts the cycle error and carries clock-regime uncertainty.

per_cell_residual_formula.description: Per-cell signed log-ratio of predicted cycles p_i to true cycles t_i.

geomean_relative_error_formula.description: Log-space geomean relative error built from the absolute per-cell log-ratios.

median_abs_log_relative_error_formula.description: Median absolute log-relative error over scored cells.

bootstrap_statistic.description: The statistic resampled to form the bootstrap upper bound is the log-space geomean relative error.

epsilon_floor_applied.description: No epsilon floor is applied. Cycle predictions and labels are strictly positive (cycle counts in the thousands), unlike the bounded-fraction cache runner.

requires_strictly_positive_inputs.description: Both predicted and true cycle counts must be strictly positive; a non-positive input is rejected rather than floored.

forbidden_bounded_fraction_formula.description: The bounded-fraction cache formula is explicitly recorded as forbidden for the cycle target. A runner that scores cycles with this formula instead of the pinned log-ratio formula is non-conformant.

geomean_relative_error_max.description: Maximum admissible log-space geomean relative error.

median_abs_log_relative_error_max.description: Maximum admissible median absolute log-relative error.

bootstrap_geomean_upper_bound_max.description: Maximum admissible 95 percent bootstrap upper bound on the geomean relative error.

bootstrap_resamples.description: Bootstrap resample count, matching the pinned cache-runner bootstrap.

bootstrap_ci_confidence.description: Bootstrap confidence level, matching the pinned cache-runner bootstrap.

closes_research_success.description: Passing the cycle publication gate is what closes the success terminal state. The cycle headline is the only leg permitted to do so.

reports_only.description: The smoke tier reports the three metrics but is non-publication.

closes_research_success.description: A smoke-tier run can never close the success terminal state; only the publication gate can.

role.description: The nanosecond leg is a derived clock-uncertainty interval, never a co-equal headline. Pinning this as a const means a contract that promotes the nanosecond leg to a headline role fails validation.

closes_research_success_alone.description: The nanosecond leg may not close the success terminal state on its own. A contract that permits a sub-floor nanosecond result to close success fails validation.

requires_crosswalk_artifact.description: A same-binary, same-shape agreement (crosswalk) artifact between the deploy observable and the NCU reference duration must exist before any deploy-nanosecond claim.

crosswalk_reference_metric_id.description: The NCU reference duration the crosswalk compares against.

crosswalk_deploy_observable.description: The deploy-legal dual-source observable (CUPTI Activity plus CUDA event) the crosswalk validates against the NCU reference.

dual_source_noise_floor_ns.description: Provenanced p99 dual-source reconciliation noise floor in nanoseconds for this host. Any deploy-nanosecond claim must clear it floor-relative.

floor_relative_bound_default.description: Default floor-relative nanosecond bound: the noise floor must be at most this fraction of the cohort kernel duration.

min_cohort_duration_ns_for_default_bound.description: Minimum cohort kernel duration (noise floor divided by the default bound) for the default floor-relative nanosecond claim to be possible.

tighter_bound.description: Tighter floor-relative nanosecond bound available once longer kernels are authored.

min_cohort_duration_ns_for_tighter_bound.description: Minimum cohort kernel duration (noise floor divided by the tighter bound) for the tighter floor-relative nanosecond claim to be possible.

min.description: Lower bound of the plausible SM-clock band for the cycles-to-nanoseconds conversion; outside the band the conversion fails closed.

max.description: Upper bound of the plausible SM-clock band for the cycles-to-nanoseconds conversion; outside the band the conversion fails closed.

research_success.description: Terminal state recorded when the cycle publication gate passes.

verdict_falsification.description: Terminal state recorded when a leg is honestly refuted below its floor; a first-class outcome, never a silent or reported-only result.

deferred_cross_arch_requires_sm120_sessi.description: Sentinel recorded for any cross-architecture leg this single-architecture session cannot witness.

evidence_statuses.description: The only evidence statuses this single-architecture host may record. Cross-architecture and Blackwell-laptop statuses are excluded by the closed item enum.
